map.输入回波强度、回波顶高、回波面积，综合评估对流强度等级、冰雹概率与降水贡献。: Enter the echo intensity, echo top height and echo area to comprehensively assess the convective intensity grade, hail probability and precipitation contribution.
map.📖 查看「雷达回波强度评估 使用指南」: 📖 View the "Radar Echo Intensity Assessment User Guide"
map.雷达回波强度：反射率因子 Z=10^(dBZ/10)，降水率 R=(Z/200): Radar echo intensity: reflectivity factor Z=10^(dBZ/10), rain rate R=(Z/200)^(1/1.6) mm/h; hail probability is estimated jointly from dBZ and echo top height h; liquid water content VIL=3.44×10⁻⁶·Z^(4/7)·h (kg/m²); the convective grade is determined by dBZ thresholds (<30 weak convection, <50 strong convection, ≥55 hail possible, ≥60 strong hail), and the precipitation contribution is estimated from area and intensity.
map.💡 冰雹概率 PH = clamp(0.6·(dBZ-40)/30 + 0.4·: 💡 Hail probability PH = clamp(0.6·(dBZ-40)/30 + 0.4·(H-5)/10); convective intensity is determined from dBZ combined with echo top height; VIL approximation = 3.44e-6·Z^(4/7)·H.
map.冰雹概率为基于 dBZ 与回波顶高的经验估算，实际需结合探空与环境场: The hail probability is an empirical estimate based on dBZ and echo top height; in practice it must be combined with sounding and environmental fields
map.VIL（垂直积分液态水含量）采用单层近似，仅作量级参考: VIL (vertically integrated liquid water) uses a single-layer approximation and is only an order-of-magnitude reference
map.回波顶高一般指 18 dBZ 回波所在高度: The echo top height generally refers to the height of the 18 dBZ echo
map.由风速与风压估结构受力。: Estimate structural loads from wind speed and wind pressure.
map.风速 20 m/s、空气密度 1.225 → 动压=0.5×1.225×20²≈: Wind speed 20 m/s, air density 1.225 → dynamic pressure = 0.5×1.225×20² ≈ 245 Pa; a 10 m² windward face receives about 2450 N ≈ 250 kgf of thrust.
map.设计抗风 0.5 kPa，实际 0.245 kPa 余量足；阵风 30 m/s→: Design wind resistance 0.5 kPa, actual 0.245 kPa leaves ample margin; a gust of 30 m/s → 0.55 kPa exceeds the design, requiring reinforcement.
map.风压和风速平方关系？: Is wind pressure related to wind speed squared?
map.动压∝风速平方，风速翻倍推力变 4 倍，所以大风破坏骤增。: Dynamic pressure ∝ wind speed squared; doubling the wind speed quadruples the thrust, so gale damage increases sharply.
map.风压单位 Pa 多大？: How large is the wind pressure unit Pa?
map.1 Pa=1 N/m²，250 Pa 看似小但对大面积广告牌乘面积后总力很大。: 1 Pa=1 N/m²; 250 Pa seems small but multiplied by the area of a large billboard the total force is very large.
map.输入雷达回波强度、回波顶高和回波面积，综合评估对流强度等级，估算冰雹概率、垂直积: Enter the radar echo intensity, echo top height and echo area to comprehensively assess the convective intensity grade, estimate the hail probability, the vertically integrated liquid water (VIL) and the regional precipitation magnitude, providing a quantitative reference for severe convection warnings.
